en: Black‑and‑white vertical postcard view of a quiet European village street leading toward a tall church with a distinctive baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome topped by a cross. On the right are steeply tiled roofs with flagpoles and a hanging round sign on one building, possibly an inn or shop. Trees line the street and partially obscure the church and adjacent houses. A torn edge is visible on the lower right of the card.
